profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Zus Health
profile.summary: Product-minded software engineer with 16 years in healthcare data infrastructure, joining early-stage teams and turning "zero-to-one" ambiguity into reliable, scalable systems. Equally comfortable building the product, running a sales demo, scoping a roadmap, mentoring engineers, or triaging a production incident. Strong product instincts paired with consistent, hands-on execution.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead responsible for Zus's value-based care product vertical (including risk adjustment and transitions of care features), EHR integrations (Athena, eCW, Epic, Elation, etc.) and provider-facing web application. Work spans frontend (React) and backend (AWS/Node), and includes end-to-end ownership from roadmap planning through technical execution and production operations.

positions.title: Director Of Engineering
positions.description: Responsible for 3 teams with 20+ developers building Azara's population health and care management products used by over 400 healthcare organizations across the country.

positions.title: Product Architect
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

- Lead engineering team in a combination of product management and software architecture
- Design solutions for loading and consuming healthcare data
- Oversee implementation including code reviews, design reviews, and collaboration with all teams across the company
- Part time individual contributor on certain projects

Skills:

- Full stack software development in a .NET environment using C#/SQL/Javascript. Strong background in SQL and data modeling. Currently working on API and web application design and development.
- Strong healthcare IT expertise, specifically in outpatient clinical data and clinical quality measurement, as well as healthcare terminologies such as RxNorm/ICD-10/etc.
- Strong communication and leadership skills developed over growing Azara from 4 to 40+ employees. Extensive experience training technical and non-technical employees on our product, development practices, and healthcare IT in general.

positions.title: Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
- Full stack software development in a .NET environment. Proficient in C# and Javascript, very strong SQL and data modeling skills.
- Working closely with our product management team to define and review requirements.
- Overseeing our database team including code reviews, training, interviewing new candidates, and continuously pushing for improvement in our development process.

My key recent accomplishments at Azara include:

- Development of our reporting framework and over 500 clinical quality measures. Led the certification effort of our Meaningful Use eCQM's.
- Introduction of software best practices such as continuous integration, automated testing in all levels of our stack, etc.
- Development of internal tools used to monitor and configure hundreds of ETL processes running every day.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: I worked as a technical consultant on a variety of healthcare information technology related projects. These ranged from EMR implementations and customizations to data warehousing and reporting solutions. I was responsible for all aspects of the delivery life cycle, and frequently contributed to business development and account management. One of my largest projects at Arcadia was a data warehousing and reporting solution that became the foundation for Azara Healthcare.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Interned as a software developer/DBA responsible for developing new enhancements and bug fixes for the main product, a .NET based web application providing information and analytical tools for financial professionals.

projects.title: Gunswap Juggling Animator
projects.description:
Sole developer on open source, web-based, juggling animator.

Project website: http://www.gunswap.co
GitHub repo: https://github.com/yDgunz/gunswap
